entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane of adventure, treasures and potent mana, littered with floating hedrons.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: The Kor lithomancer who created the hedrons and, with Ugin and Sorin, trapped the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Nahiri and Sorin trap the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Nahiri and Ugin trap the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker whose meeting in the Eye of Ugin loosened the Eldrazi's bonds.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who met Sarkhan and Jace in the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who met Sarkhan and Chandra in the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: The elf who released the Eldrazi, thinking they would leave Zendikar.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads a group facing the Eldrazi alongside Zendikar's residents.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A trapped planeswalker-turned-demon desperate for a way off Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan still around two years after the initial destruction.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Horrendous colorless beings trapped on Zendikar by hedrons and later released.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A chamber where Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace met.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Large floating polyhedron-shaped stones created by Nahiri to trap the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin Markov use hedrons to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
events.quote: Together with Ugin and Sorin Markov she used them to trap the horrendous Eldrazi on the plane.

events.summary: Thousands of years later, Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace meet in the Eye of Ugin chamber, unintentionally loosening the bonds on the Eldrazi.
events.quote: unintentionally loosened the bonds that kept the Eldrazi in torpor.

events.summary: Nissa releases the Eldrazi, thinking they would leave Zendikar behind; she is wrong.
events.quote: The Eldrazi were finally released by the elf Nissa Revane , thinking that they would leave Zendikar far behind them.

events.summary: Gideon takes the lead of a group of planeswalkers facing the Eldrazi, while Ob Nixilis seeks a way off the plane.
events.quote: Now, Gideon Jura takes the lead of a group of planeswalkers in facing the Eldrazi alongside the residents of Zendikar.
